 Lauren James injury: Chelsea star to miss at least five games
 Chelsea Women manager Sonia Bompastor says a scan showed a hamstring injury for Lauren James, who BBC Sport reports will miss at least five matches and may miss England's Ukraine play-offs.
 By Matt Price Verified Data + AI Published 6 Nov 2026, 18:41 Read me this article 3 min G Add as preferred source 
 Lauren James will miss at least Chelsea ’s next five matches with a hamstring injury, including the meeting with title rivals Manchester City , BBC Sport reports.
 Sonia Bompastor confirmed on Friday 6 November that a scan had identified the problem after James was forced off during Chelsea’s 6-0 win at Charlton on Sunday. The head coach said the forward would be unavailable for the remainder of the current fixture block.
 There was better Chelsea Women injury news on Lexi Potter, who is back in contention for Saturday’s match against Everton at Stamford Bridge.
 Lauren James injury confirmed after hamstring scan
 James, 25, was replaced by Erin Cuthbert after 35 minutes at The Valley. Chelsea initially needed further assessment before establishing the extent of the injury.
 Bompastor has now confirmed the diagnosis in Chelsea’s update on James and Potter .

 “LJ will be missing the games until the end of the block,” she said.
 The news rules James out of Everton’s visit on Saturday 7 November and the Manchester City match the following weekend, according to BBC Sport’s report on her expected absence .
 Chelsea lead the Women’s Super League on goal difference ahead of City, making the loss of James particularly significant before their meeting.
 When will Lauren James return?
 No exact Lauren James return date has been announced. BBC Sport reports that she will miss a minimum of five Chelsea matches, while Bompastor described the absence in terms of the current block of fixtures.
 That does not confirm she will be fit immediately after the fifth game. Chelsea have not named a comeback fixture.
 Fixture Timing James’s availability 
 Chelsea vs Everton Saturday 7 November Out 
 Chelsea vs Manchester City The following weekend Out 
 England vs Ukraine qualifying play-offs December Uncertain 
 The injury also raises doubts over James’s availability for England’s World Cup qualifying play-offs against Ukraine in December. She has not been confirmed out of those matches.
 Lexi Potter returns after knee problem
 Potter offers Bompastor another midfield option against Everton after returning to training with the squad this week.
 She missed the Charlton victory with a small knee injury sustained during Chelsea’s 2-0 Women’s Champions League win over Roma.
 “We have Lexi Potter who is back in the squad and in contention for the game,” Bompastor said.
 Her return follows an England debut last month. Our earlier report on Potter’s progress at Chelsea and with England looks at her growing role.
 How Chelsea plan to cope without James
 Bompastor acknowledged James’s importance but pointed to Chelsea’s ability to share goals across the team.
 The six-goal win at Charlton offered evidence of that attacking depth. The manager highlighted contributions from several scorers and said every Chelsea player who appeared had attempted a shot.
 “Of course we know how good Lauren is for us and for the team,” Bompastor said.
 Finding a solution now becomes part of Chelsea’s preparations for a run that includes their closest challengers. Potter’s return improves Bompastor’s options, although the coach has not confirmed how she will reshape the side without James.
 Chelsea face Everton at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 7 November before turning their attention to Manchester City the following weekend.
